'''Long-range comlinks''' were a more advanced model of [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] with a range greater than that of normal comlinks. Some were as large as backpack-sized, and allowed a user to communicate with a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] within the same [[Star system/Legends|star system]].
